betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Multiple matrix compartments act as one unit. Starting at the ME entry point, they receive items and fluids in pattern order.

For example, with a pattern of A/B/B/C, four item compartments receive A, B, B and C in order. The two B inputs stay separate.

Place compartments of the same type in a straight line, all facing the same way, horizontally or vertically. Use only one ME entry for the whole group.
